subject: Post-close treasury consolidation: invoice routing & entity for Acadia Therapeutics
messages:
From: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@acadia.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-close invoices & new wire instructions

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note now that the acquisition closed last Friday — Acadia Therapeutics is consolidating treasury and we need Redwood invoices routed to the acquiring entity going forward. Can you do the following so our AP team can process the outstanding balance and future invoices?

- Reissue outstanding invoices (PO 4721) to: Acadia Therapeutics, Inc. — 220 Harbor Way, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02110 (EIN: 04-1234567)
- Send wire instructions to purchasing@acadia.com and to our treasury lead (cc below)
- Indicate on the invoice the original Redwood subscription order number and reference our PO 4721
- Include VAT/GST breakdown if applicable and provide your tax residency / W-9 equivalent for US reporting

We’ve attached our new PO and the preferred wire instructions. Treasury will centralize payments under Acadia Treasury (same-day ACH/wire). Please confirm what you need from legal (signed amendment, updated SOW) to proceed.

Thanks,
Marco Ruiz
VP Finance, Acadia Therapeutics
m.ruiz@acadia.com
Attachments: Acadia_PO_4721.pdf, acadia_new_wire_instructions.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-close invoices & new wire instructions

Marco — thanks and congrats on the close. Welcome, Acadia team.

We can reissue and route invoices to Acadia Therapeutics, but we need a couple of items before finance can push the credits/credits and new invoices live:

1) Signed amendment or DocuSign that confirms legal payee change (we can accept the signed PDF).
2) W-9 or tax residency document for Acadia (for tax reporting). For international VAT/GST, let us know Acadia’s VAT registration country and number.
3) Confirm whether all historic invoices should be credited and reissued, or only invoices going forward (we typically issue a credit memo + reissued invoice when legal entity changes).
4) Confirm the AP contact for remittance follow-up (name/email) and a single mailing address for paper copies if required.

Action plan from our side: Rishi will handle the credit memos and reissued invoices. Aditya will update the PO mapping in our billing system so future invoices reference PO 4721 automatically. I’ve attached a one-page billing change request form that speeds approvals on our side — please complete and return.

If you can get the signed amendment and the W-9/tax docs this week we’ll prioritize reissuing the outstanding balance.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0147
Attachments: acadia-billing-change-request-form.pdf

Kimberly — thanks, sending the signed amendment and W-9 now.

We’ve attached the signed DocuSign packet (signed-amendment-ACAD-Redwood.pdf) and a PDF of Acadia’s W-9 equivalent. Treasury will act as centralized payer going forward — Sara Bennett (sara.bennett@acadia.com) is the treasury contact for payment confirmations.

To confirm your questions:
- Please credit and reissue historic invoices tied to the Redwood subscription back to the effective acquisition date (2028-09-29). We expect a single reissued invoice per original invoice.
- AP will process the outstanding balance within 30 days of receiving the reissued invoices and the wire instructions.
- Contact for any tax residency questions is our tax counsel (tax@acadia.com).

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/doc/EXAMPLE-SIGN-12345

Thanks — Marco

Kim / Aditya — looping in our internal plan so we’re aligned.

Summary of action items (finance):
- Once we receive the signed amendment and W-9 we will: 1) create credit memos for invoices dated before 2028-09-29, 2) reissue invoices with new legal payee line (Acadia Therapeutics, Inc.; include original invoice reference and PO 4721).
- Tax handling: Acadia indicates US EIN; no VAT for US -> flag in the invoice as N/A but include a note with Acadia’s tax counsel contact. If Acadia later requests VAT format for EU subsidiaries, we will issue an addendum schedule.
- Payment terms: AP commits to 30 days after reissue. If payment is delayed >60 days we will evaluate a temporary service hold per our collections policy and escalate to Sales Ops.
- System work: Aditya to map PO 4721 to the Acadia account in billing system and tag all active subscriptions to new payee.

Attachments to be generated by finance team: reissued invoices (PDF), credit memos (PDF), and bank remittance confirmation template. I’ll queue these for priority processing once Kimberly confirms DocuSign and the W-9 are in our ticket.
